item.title: Version 0.8
item.description:
✨ New Features

  • Color Picker: a Display popup re-expresses the reading as sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB (1998), L*a*b* or Simulation CMYK; a Simulate popup picks the CMYK profile (the document's PDF/X output intent first, otherwise one you choose); and a separations readout lists the process and spot plates with total area coverage, flagged over 300 %
  • The Info sidebar lists the document's output intents under Features
  • A Window menu, so macOS window tiling, full screen and Cmd + M work
  • Hold Cmd + Q to quit, as in Chrome — a quick press only shows a reminder. Galley ▸ Warn Before Quitting turns it off
  • File ▸ Close, without a key; bind Cmd + W yourself if you want it

🔄 Changes

  • Galley now requires macOS 12 (Monterey) or later

🐛 Fixes

  • On macOS 27, Space, Page Down, Page Up and the arrow keys turn the page again in Single Page and Two Pages modes

item.title: Version 0.7
item.description:
✨ New Features

  • Color Picker (View ▸ Color Picker, Shift + Cmd + K, or right-click ▸ Color Picker) — a Digital Color Meter-style panel that reports the color under the cursor as the PDF's own values (DeviceCMYK, DeviceGray, Separation, DeviceN, ICCBased), read from the content stream rather than sampled from the screen. Click to lock a reading, click again to release
  • Edit ▸ Copy Color as Text (Shift + Cmd + C) and Copy Color as PDF (Option + Cmd + C), the same keys as Digital Color Meter. The PDF is a 64 pt vector swatch that carries its color space, so Illustrator receives a Separation as a spot swatch
  • Character Inspection now shows the character's fill color as written in the PDF

item.title: Version 0.6
item.description:
🔄 Changes

  • Galley no longer switches macOS font smoothing off at launch. Text is drawn at the system default weight, so a page now looks exactly as it does in Preview — both use the same PDFKit engine, and the smoothing setting was the only thing making Galley's body text look lighter
  • Prefer the thinner rendering? It is two defaults write commands away; see Text Weight in the documentation

ℹ️ Upgrading

  • Versions up to 0.5 wrote AppleFontSmoothing and CGFontRenderingFontSmoothingDisabled into Galley's preferences on every launch, and updating does not remove them. If text still looks thinner than in Preview, run defaults delete com.github.munepi.galley CGFontRenderingFontSmoothingDisabled and defaults delete com.github.munepi.galley AppleFontSmoothing once, then relaunch

item.title: Version 0.5
item.description:
✨ New Features

  • Page Color (View ▸ Page Color) — recolors the page for comfortable reading. Dark and Charcoal invert the page while leaving embedded photographs positive; Sepia, Orange and Gray tint the paper and leave the ink alone
  • Every preset keeps a WCAG AAA (7:1) contrast ratio, and the change is display-only — copying, exporting and printing keep the document's original colors
  • Standard macOS find keys: Cmd + G / Shift + Cmd + G step through matches whether or not the search bar is focused, and Cmd + E searches for the current selection
  • A Match Case option in the search bar, applying to plain and regular-expression searches alike
  • Navigation history: Cmd + [ / Cmd + ] return to where you were before following a link, a bookmark, a search match or a Forward Search

🔄 Changes

  • The hidden Opt + J / Opt + K page aliases are gone. Every command is now a single, uniquely titled menu item, so any of them can be rebound from System Settings, defaults or Karabiner-Elements
  • Regular-expression search is no longer forced to be case-insensitive; the Match Case checkbox decides

item.title: Version 0.4
item.description:
✨ New Features

  • New galleypdf command, shipped inside the application bundle — open a PDF, jump to a page, force a reload, or run a SyncTeX forward search from your shell, your editor, or a build script
  • Homebrew tap: brew install --cask munepi/galley/galley installs Galley and puts galleypdf on your PATH
  • New URL scheme endpoint galleypdf://open?pdfpath=<path>&page=<page>
  • Every galleypdf:// endpoint now accepts background=1, so a forward search never takes focus away from your editor

🔄 Changes

  • The disk image now contains GalleyPDF.app itself instead of a .pkg installer, so updates no longer ask for an administrator password
  • displayline.bash has been replaced by galleypdf displayline, which takes the same arguments without the AppleScript round trip

item.title: Version 0.3
item.description:
✨ New Features

  • PDF Info sidebar with five panels — Info (Document Info, PDF/X, PDF/A, PDF/UA, Security, Pages, Features), Fonts (CGPDFDocument scan walking inherited page resources and Form XObjects), XMP (raw packet parsed into sections), Bookmarks (click-to-navigate), and Annotations (click-to-navigate, Cmd+C copies content)
  • View menu shortcuts: PDF Info (Cmd+I), PDF Bookmarks (Cmd+B), PDF Annotations (Cmd+N)
  • Export PDF Info as Markdown or JSON via File ▸ Export ▸ … (All / Info / Fonts / XMP / Bookmarks / Annotations) and the in-panel Export dropdown
  • Main window position and size are now persisted across launches

item.title: Version 0.2
item.description:
✨ New Features

  • Sparkle 2 auto-update support ("Check for Updates..." menu)
  • Daily automatic update checks against the stable appcast
  • Marquee selection UX improvements in PDF view
  • Debug logging via os_log with subsystem filtering
  • Generation token guard against race conditions on PDF reload

🛠 Improvements

  • Refined page input HUD behavior
